subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live owner-session delivery proof, or may maintainers accept source and regression-test proof for this session-routing change?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and source-reproducible, but the affected behavior is user-visible Telegram/session delivery and the PR itself states live proof is still pending.

options.title: Require live delivery proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing the background-task completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source, tests, and CI only, but then own the remaining real-transport message-delivery risk.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery contract
options.body: If the desired policy should cover more wake classes than background-task completions, pause this PR and fold its tests into a broader task-completion delivery design.

recommendation.title: Require live delivery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing the background-task completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is proof sufficiency around session/message delivery, and steipete has adjacent subagent announce and heartbeat delivery history in the touched path.
